faqs.q: What is the 3 Segment Clamp for Storz used for?
faqs.a: The 3 Segment Clamp for Storz is a three-segment clamp that holds a hose onto the tail of a Storz coupling, made in Taiwan in forged aluminium(6061). Size range: 3"-6".

faqs.q: How do I specify the 3 Segment Clamp for Storz when ordering?
faqs.a: The 3 Segment Clamp for Storz has no size table of its own. Quote the size and any variant you need (3"-6") through our contact page and we confirm the manufacturer part number against your application.

faqs.q: What sizes does the 3 Segment Clamp for Storz come in?
faqs.a: The 3 Segment Clamp for Storz is listed in 3"-6". Match the gasket or clamp to the Storz size you are fitting, and tell us the size and quantity when you order so we confirm the exact part with the manufacturer.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of the 3 Segment Clamp for Storz?
faqs.a: Choose the size by the Storz size marking or lug distance of the heads you are joining, not by the hose bore alone. The 3 Segment Clamp for Storz is sized 3"-6".

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the 3 Segment Clamp for Storz?
faqs.a: The manufacturer does not publish a working pressure for the 3 Segment Clamp for Storz. Give us your working pressure and medium when you enquire and we check it with the manufacturer before you order.

faqs.q: What is the 3 Segment Clamp for Storz made of?
faqs.a: The 3 Segment Clamp for Storz is made of forged aluminium(6061). Notes from the maker: Forged Aluminum 3 Segment Clamp for Storz Coupling. Compatible with Storz Coupling with Safety Pin.

faqs.q: What does the 3 Segment Clamp for Storz connect to?
faqs.a: The 3 Segment Clamp for Storz mates with any Storz head of the same size, since Storz is symmetrical and has no male or female half. It does not connect to cam and groove, Guillemin or threaded fittings without an adapter, so see our [cam and groove couplings](/c/cam-and-groove-couplings) for that style.

faqs.q: How should the 3 Segment Clamp for Storz be inspected and maintained?
faqs.a: On the 3 Segment Clamp for Storz, each Storz joint seals on the gasket in the face of the head, so inspect it at every make-up; the manufacturer fits a discharge gasket as standard and a suction gasket to order. Where a hose is dragged or vibrates, a safety latch stops the heads turning apart; see the [Storz size guide](/blog/storz-coupling-sizes) for gaskets and lug distances.
